description_en: Queries the publishing details of a schema design ticket
description_zh: 获取结构设计工单的发布详情
name: ListDDLPublishRecords

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the ticket.

You can create a schema design ticket in the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69711.html. You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144649.html operation to create a schema design ticket and obtain the ID of the ticket
parameters.help_zh:
工单ID。
您可以在控制台（请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69711.html）或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144649.html接口创建结构设计工单，并获取工单ID
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, log on to the DMS console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

DDLPublishRecordList.description_en: The details of the publishing records

AuditExpireTime.description_en: The time when the approval expires

AuditStatus.description_en:
The approval state of the ticket. Valid values:

EXEMPT_PASS: The ticket passes without approval.
TO_AUDIT: The ticket is pending for approval.
CANCEL: The ticket is canceled.
SUCCESS: The ticket is approved.
FAIL: The ticket fails to pass the approval
AuditStatus.description_zh:
审批状态，取值如下：
EXEMPT_PASS：免批通过
TO_AUDIT：等待审批
CANCEL：撤销审批
SUCCESS：审批通过
FAIL：未通过

CreatorId.description_en: The ID of the user who creates the ticket. You can obtain the user ID by calling the [GetUser]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147098.html） operation and querying the value of the UserId parameter. The value is not the unique ID (UID) of the Alibaba Cloud account
CreatorId.description_zh: 工单创建人的用户ID（可通过[GetUser]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147098.html）接口获取的UserId参数），非阿里云UID

Finality.description_en:
Indicates whether the approval is terminated. Valid values:

true: The approval is terminated.
false: The approval is not terminated.

Multiple reasons can terminate the approval. For example, you withdraw the application or your ticket is not approved before the specified time
Finality.description_zh:
是否终止，取值为：
true：是
false：否
导致终止的原因有审批撤回或在指定执行时间前未完成审批等

PublishStatus.description_en:
The publishing state of the ticket. Valid values:

START: The ticket is created.
ANALYZE: The ticket is under analysis.
AUDIT: The ticket is under approval.
DISPATCH: A task is generated for the ticket.
SUCCESS: The task is successful
PublishStatus.description_zh:
发布状态，取值如下：
START：创建
ANALYZE：分析
AUDIT：审批
DISPATCH：调度
SUCCESS：成功

items.description_en: The information about the publishing task

Logic.description_en:
Indicates whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:

true: The database is a logical database.
false: the database is not a logical database
Logic.description_zh:
是否为逻辑库，取值：
true：是
false：否

PlanTime.description_en: The time to publish the ticket

PublishJobList.description_en: The list of the publishing tasks

items.description_en: The details of the publishing task

DBTaskGroupId.description_en: The ID of the SQL task group

ExecuteCount.description_en: The number of SQL statements that are executed

Scripts.example: ALTER TABLE test_toolkit_rename_table_after_rename MODIFY COLUMN gmt_modified datetime NOT NULL

TableName.description_en: The name of the table after the change

TaskJobStatus.description_en:
The state of the publishing task. Valid values:

NONE: The state of the task is unknown.
SUCCESS: The task is successful.
FAIL: The task fails
TaskJobStatus.description_zh:
发布任务状态，取值如下：
NONE：未知
SUCCESS：执行成功
FAIL：执行失败

PublishStrategy.description_en:
The publishing policy. Valid values:

IMMEDIATELY: immediately publishes the ticket.
REGULARLY: publishes the ticket at a scheduled time
PublishStrategy.description_zh:
发布策略，取值：
IMMEDIATELY：立即执行
REGULARLY：定时执行

RiskLevel.description_en:
The risk level of the operation. Valid values:

NONE_RISK: The operation does not have risks.
LOW_RISK: The operation is at low risk.
MIDDLE_RISK: The operation is at medium risk.
HIGH_RISK: The operation is at high risk
RiskLevel.description_zh:
风险等级，取值如下：
NONE_RISK：无风险
LOW_RISK：低风险
MIDDLE_RISK：中风险
HIGH_RISK：高风险

StatusDesc.description_en: The description of the publishing state

WorkflowInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the approval process

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
